population: clean-lineage B2B train1421 folds0-3, one fixed V8 order per query
events: all 12 add-only transitions; exact fidelity change; exact rendered-token increment; 0.90 rollback if prior prefix succeeds and successor fails; large negative change if delta fidelity <= -0.10
size_stratum: top three packet-token increments within each 12-step query versus other nine; no global token cutoff fitted from outcome
narrow_window: first consecutive run of 0.90 success contains exactly one prefix; audit the next packet that terminates that first run
association_gate: at least 20 0.90 rollback transitions and top-three size-stratum rollback rate at least twice the other-nine rate to justify designing a bounded split-packet Target-call pilot; correlation alone does not prove split benefit
